recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13533 unless a future terminology review finds a separate THO media-category problem.
issue_request: FHIR-13533 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request to change the old Digital Media Type value set code from photo to image because the definition covered scanned documents, charts, ECG images, and other unmoving images broader than photographs.
initial_application: Commit 17a86882a2 changed the Media spreadsheet's digital-media-type row from photo/Photo to image/Image and added committee note gf#13533. The STU3 historical generated bundle still shows the pre-application photo code, but R4 history and the current checked-in Media spreadsheet use image.
additional_context: The current combined branch has no active Media entry in source/fhir.ini's [resources] list, so the old Media resource/value-set source is not a current resource build input. Current active DocumentReference value sets reference terminology.hl7.org media-category, and R5 historical expansion contains image/video/audio rather than photo. The already-published FHIR-15605 reconciliation fixed remaining same-family Media.type wording and cited FHIR-13533 as already reflected in the code list.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The source and published terminology surfaces that still expose this media category already use image, while editing out-of-build Media files or external terminology references would not improve the current FHIR core specification.

related_jiras.note: Already-published reconciliation fixed stale Media.type wording and noted that FHIR-13533's photo-to-image code change was already present.
